name: Montara SB
description: Montara State Beach is a sandy San Mateo coast beach surrounded by rocky outcrops, popular for beachcombing, surfing, and shore fishing. Across Highway 1, the McNee Ranch area offers trails on Montara Mountain.
fullDescription: Montara State Beach is a sandy San Mateo coast beach surrounded by rocky outcrops, popular for beachcombing, surfing, and shore fishing. Across Highway 1, the McNee Ranch area offers trails on Montara Mountain.
whatTheyOffer:
- Sandy beach for strolling, surfing, and shore fishing (reached by staircase)
- Hiking and horseback riding trails at McNee Ranch on Montara Mountain, east of Highway 1
- Leashed dogs allowed
- No drinking water and no camping
howToGetIt: Open 8 a.m. to sunset. No day-use fee is listed. Horses are allowed only on trails east of Highway 1. Overnight stays nearby are available at the Point Montara Lighthouse hostel.
keywords: Montara, state beach, San Mateo County, coastal, surfing, tide pools, McNee Ranch
